title: Patience
description: Patience means waiting well — trusting God's timing instead of getting frustrated or giving up.

waypoints.title: Waiting Well
waypoints.body: Waiting is hard, especially for something you really want. The Bible doesn't tell us waiting is easy -- it tells us who to trust while we wait.

waypoints.title: Waiting for Something
waypoints.body: Tell about a time you had to wait for something. Was it hard to be patient? What helped?
